questions.question: What is DHCP?
questions.answer: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) automatically assigns IP addresses and network configuration settings to devices.

questions.answer: An abstract method is a method declared without an implementation and must be implemented by subclasses.

questions.answer: Preemptive scheduling allows the operating system to interrupt a running process and allocate the CPU to another process.

questions.answer: A transitive dependency occurs when a non-key attribute depends on another non-key attribute.

questions.question: What is dynamic programming?
questions.answer: Dynamic programming is an optimization technique that solves overlapping subproblems and stores their results to avoid redundant computation.
